notes.title: Early Access Update 1.40: A.I. Opponents & Revamped Online Experience
notes.notes:
Today we’re happy to announce that the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/981630/Guntastic/] fourth, largest-to-date Early Access update for Guntastic is now available on Steam[/url]! This update has been a long time coming and includes several features that we hope will help spark new interest in the game as we approach the final release on PC and Xbox.

[h1]A.I. Opponents[/h1] 
One of the main issues with Guntastic was that it didn’t offer a single player mode. Since the game has unfortunately failed to attract a large online player base so far, this resulted in a lot of people being unable to play the game at all. To fix this issue [b]we’re now introducing A.I. opponents[/b].

[previewyoutube=EH7hTcawHTY;full][/previewyoutube]
Bots can [b]fill-up vacant slots in both local and online games[/b] and offer four difficulty levels: [u]Easy[/u], [u]Normal[/u], [u]Hard[/u] and [u]Ludicrous[/u]. This feature is still a work-in-progress and we’re looking for feedback, just beware when playing at [u]Ludicrous[/u] level as bots tend to become extremely cunning. ☠
 
Make sure to [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/981630/Guntastic/]tune in on Steam[/url] or on [url=https://www.twitch.tv/weareludicrous]our brand new Twitch channel[/url] as we’ll be streaming CPU-only gameplay that we’ll be using to fine tune AI design and behavior in the future.

[h1]Revamped Online Experience[/h1] 
Another problem that arises from having a small online player base is that [b]finding a match can take way too much time[/b]. While this will always be an issue to a certain degree, we identified several flaws in the way we designed public matchmaking for Guntastic that made the problem sensibly worse:

[olist][*][b]No real indication of how many players and games were available[/b]. One could only press “Play with anybody” and cross his fingers.[/*]
[*][b]Games could only be joined at lobby time[/b]. That’s nice – provided you have an enormous amount of players and games available at any given time.[/*]
[*][b]Public games couldn’t be customized at all[/b], leaving players stuck playing the same way over and over again.[/*][/olist]
In this version we introduced a handful of new features that should streamline the online multiplayer experience: from finding a game, to the lobby, to the game itself. When opening the [u]Play Online[/u] section of the menu you’ll now be welcomed by a redesigned interface:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34006915/450314580698812576037ebe2e17f59dcf633158.gif[/img]

Here you can select a game to join directly, or ask the system to find the best one for you (just like it was already possible). [b]In-progress games can now be joined as well[/b], or you can explicitly decide to create a new one.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34006915/06ab02b90e96a8898d3cc19dcfc488c8585e2f61.gif[/img]
[i]«From great power comes great responsibility.»[/i]

The lobby itself was updated to let you move back and forth between the character and level selection screens as you wish, reducing the number of steps required to start the game. [b]Game Rules can now be customized in public multiplayer sessions[/b] and new rules are available to control CPU players and player count. Finally, the new player menu provides access to additional player information and moderation actions (kick).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34006915/a56dd071bc621c133adfc4a9ccb0ce4ea6d19dfa.png[/img]
[i]Ruthless 1 vs. 1 competitions are now possible.[/i]

[h1]New Scoreboard[/h1] 
Due to some specific Xbox requirements we had rethink the overall design of the scoreboard screen. The new version should be much cleaner to read and also provides a quick way to [b]find out more about your opponents and eventually add them as friends[/b] for future games.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34006915/8eda58fbb84d93e5110ff8d52fc7d1cc251530ca.gif[/img]

[h1]Additional Improvements[/h1]
[list][*]Notifications are now shown each time a player joins/leaves the lobby or an in-progress game.[/*][*]New animated menu background, featuring all the locations available in the game.[/*][*]Powerup bubble animations were given a final update and are now pixel-perfect like everything else in the game.[/*][*]The Central Station stage received a final visuals update.[/*][*]The background of the High Voltage stage was darkened to increase visual clarity and make game action easier to follow.[/*][*]Buttons and levers were updated to match the surrounding level theme.[/*][*]Effort sounds are now played when characters jump and land.[/*][*]Fixed a network replication issue that made grenades jitter on remote clients.[/*][*]Fixed available weapon not being randomized after a pickup was disabled by a generator in the High Voltage level.[/*][*]Fixed edge case where kills performed with the sawmill lift immediately after activating it would be awarded to the wrong player.[/*][*]Fixed application icon not being visible in the taskbar on Windows.[/*][/list] 
That’s it for now! We hope you enjoy the new features. As always we look forward to hear your feedback here or [url=https://discord.gg/DNNbHc9]on Discord[/url]!

[h3]Edit: 1.41 Hotfix now available (5 August 2020)[/h3]
After releasing version 1.40 we discovered a number of high priority issues that should now be fixed.
[list][*]Fixed crash when trying to create a local couch game with four human players.[/*][*]Fixed audio not working during local couch games.[/*][*]Fixed bug preventing invitations accepted with the game closed or on the welcome screen from working correctly.[/*][*]Fixed canceling creation/join of online games not working as expected.[/*][*]Fixed players not spawning in the correct order.[/*][*]Fixed action hints not being displayed properly during game.[/*][*]Fixed a couple of strings not being included in the Italian localization.[/*][/list]

notes.title: Early Access Update 1.30: High Voltage Potatoes
notes.notes:
Today we're releasing a new update for Guntastic, the third one since the game entered Early Access at the end of 2019. Work on this update took a bit more time than we originally anticipated, but we believe the new content will be worth the wait!

[h1]New Level: High Voltage ⚡[/h1]
Each level in Guntastic has a strong underlying theme and for this new level we wanted to play around with electricity.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34006915/cadd90d0177c11bf568224eff1556b808f6b1271.png[/img]
[i]Water and electricity, what can possibly go wrong?[/i]

[i]High Voltage[/i] is set in a hydroelectric dam, where some mad scientist has been running secret experiments on teleportation. And guess what? He succeeded! The level introduces a main new gameplay element: [b]teleporters[/b]. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34006915/123d3f00bd7c7f8ed91e4c212c0d974d3150138a.gif[/img]
[i]«Beam me up, Scotty.»[/i]

These can be used to instantly travel across the map and should make for some nice gameplay opportunities. [b]Projectiles are teleported as well[/b], so look out for that! Also watch out for the big generators at the center of the level, you sure don't want to be caught in them while they're active.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34006915/3f9452828d6741f8d516a593f954d9097455a55c.gif[/img]
[i]«1.21 Gigawatts?!?»[/i]

Make sure to use generators to your advance to [b]unlock the new [i]Electrician[/i] achievement[/b].

Another element that also makes its first appearance in this level is water. We're still experimenting with it and for now it simply slows character down while they're in it. [i]High Voltage[/i] also features a new music track whose synths and sounds should bring '70s spy and alien movies to mind.

[h1]New Character: Meet Root 🥔[/h1]
Please welcome our latest character, a mutant potato called [i]Root[/i]!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34006915/ad0932c48b9d2fd7a6c6a63a945f34315f07a580.gif[/img]
[i]«I am Root.»[/i]

As it was the case with our last character – the happy unicorn called Blue Magic – Root was also designed with feedback from our awesome community.

[h1]Bug Fixes & Improvements[/h1]
[list][*] Guntastic now uses the latest Unreal Engine version available, 4.24.3. This release brings quite a few improvements and fixes to character movement, rendering and more.[*] Fixed an issue that prevented lock-on on rockets to work correctly in some cases.[*] Network traffic is now encrypted for improved security.
[/list]
That's it for the first Guntastic update of the decade. More content awaits in future updates. As always we look forward to your feedback here or [url=https://discord.gg/DNNbHc9]on Discord[/url]!

notes.title: Early Access Update 1.20: Unicorns And Accessibility
notes.notes:
Ho-Ho-Ho! Happy holidays from the Ludicrous Games team! 🎁🎄 Today we’re releasing the second Early Access update for Guntastic, featuring a brand new character and several improvements.

[h1]New Character: Unicorn 🦄[/h1]
With the festive season just around the corner, we could’ve played it safe with some holidays-themed character. But, really, with Santas, snowmen and reindeers popping up everywhere, how boring would’ve that been?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34006915/a430540ef78baa06f662025790ac991e394d39ed.gif[/img]
[i]Giddy-up jingle unicorn, pick up your feet![/i]

Expect even crazier characters as we enter 2020, designed in strict collaboration with our awesome community. 😉

[h1]New Accessibility Features[/h1]
We deeply believe that [b]games should be as inclusive as possible[/b] and, although we’re a very small indie studio, we want Guntastic to be enjoyable by anyone. That’s why for the second Early Access update we dedicated quite some time to improving accessibility features that were already in-game and adding new ones.

[h2]1. Upcoming Color Correctness Improvements[/h2]
Guntastic heavily relies on colors to identify who's who during matches. We're now performing some tests to see how things can be improved for people with color vision deficiencies, leveraging UE4 built-in color simulation settings. More about this in a future update.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34006915/f1cf54fea0a423723a9773c9b663f4a8d3d7bf18.gif[/img]

[h2]2. Gamepad Key Remapping[/h2]
Ever wanted to fire using a trigger on your controller? Or maybe use the right analog stick for movement? That’s all possible now.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34006915/da82ae54f91c608f645fae4c1f8944e6a1a24471.png[/img]

[h2]3. In-Game Hints[/h2]
When this option is turned on, quick reminders of which keys need to be pressed to perform certain gameplay actions will be shown during gameplay (for both keyboard and controllers).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34006915/73111121a4560f7ba5a94496f1f4ace2faf4db2a.gif[/img]
[i]Now it's impossible to forget how to pick-up that weapon![/i]

[h2]4. Camera Movement Can Now Be Disabled[/h2]
If you ever experienced motion sickness while looking at Guntastic, then this option’s for you. You can also separately disable screen shake effects (i.e. during explosions) using the dedicated [i]Screen Shakes[/i] setting.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34006915/8b7c6c1c7a75bd15fef4de3468b9aa46a3c7899f.png[/img]

[h2]5. Settings Now Roam With Your Profile[/h2]
Setting up all the game’s options to your liking is tiring – and plain boring too. Most preferences are now [b]persisted to the online player profile[/b], so they’ll be automatically re-applied after reinstalling the game.

[h1]Other Notable Improvements[/h1]
[h2]Invite Friends Directly From The Lobby[/h2]
Listening to your feedback we added a [b][i]Invite Friends[/i] button to the lobby[/b] so it’s now quicker to invite friends into a public or private game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34006915/abc1596fc5b9a2e661d6d0420a7a4141527511bc.gif[/img]

[h2]Major Lift Overhaul ⬆[/h2]
Lifts were one of the first gameplay elements we experimented with while prototyping the game and, as a result, suffered from various issues (some of which were reported during the beta). For this release we [b]reworked parts of the physics and network code, so lifts should look and feel a lot smoother both locally and online.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34006915/0dc63d6d5df27799e784817aa5c8ab4762df4a30.gif[/img]
[i]Things like this should no longer happen![/i]

[h2]Homing Rockets Improvements 🚀[/h2]
We fixed some situations where homing rockets didn’t correctly track their targets. Beware! ☠

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34006915/4e1c4bdb07be506b8a6b33d26c0c48838c661e54.gif[/img]

[h1]Bug Fixes & Minor Improvements[/h1]
[list][*]Both keyboard and gamepad keys are now visible in the couch game lobby for available commands.
[*]Fixed mouse cursor not being shown in the couch game lobby.
[*]Fixed a long standing issue that could result in controller vibration continuing forever after a player was kicked in couch games.
[*]Fixed some spelling errors in the Italian localization.[/list]
That’s it for the second Early Access update. More content awaits in the next update, which is set to be released sometimes in January 2020. We can’t wait to tell you more! In the meantime, we look forward to your feedback here or [url=https://discord.gg/DNNbHc9]on Discord[/url]. Have a great holiday season!

notes.title: Early Access Update 1.10: Heavy Boots, Stage Cycle, Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
Guntastic was released to Steam Early Access one week and two days ago today! To celebrate what [strike]might seem[/strike] is a totally random amount of time since the initial release, we’re glad to announce that the very first Early Access update is now live, bringing two community-suggested features and obligatory bug fixes.
 
The game is still 10% off, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/981630/Guntastic/]go grab it while it’s hot![/url]

[h1]New Powerup: Heavy Boots[/h1] 
Who doesn’t like stomping on things to smash them? Now you can do it in Guntastic when equipped with the new Heavy Boots powerup!

[url=https://weareludicrous.com/assets/blog/ea-update-heavy-boots-stage-cycle/heavy-boots.gif][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34006915/8f90bac42be808215b71cc3de2deebeafc6d7174.gif[/img][/url]
[i][url=https://weareludicrous.com/assets/blog/ea-update-heavy-boots-stage-cycle/heavy-boots.gif]View full size[/url][/i]

The idea for this powerup came [url=https://discord.gg/DNNbHc9]from our awesome community on Discord[/url]. This is a first iteration of the powerup, so use it, break it and share your feedback!

[h1]Stage Cycle[/h1] 
Being able to select a stage to play is great. But what if you can’t get your friends to agree on which one? Luckily this will no longer be a problem thanks to the second user-suggested feature that found its way into this update.

[url=https://weareludicrous.com/assets/blog/ea-update-heavy-boots-stage-cycle/stage-cycle.gif][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34006915/0f3b9228b326e725e46a4ea090585487dccc005c.gif[/img][/url]
[i][url=https://weareludicrous.com/assets/blog/ea-update-heavy-boots-stage-cycle/stage-cycle.gif]View full size[/url][/i]

Simply select “Cycle” and you’ll play all levels at once. Well, not really at once. One per-round. But they’ll change between rounds. See? Problem solved.

[h1]Bugs Fixes & Improvements[/h1] 
For this first Early Access update we mainly focused on fixing gameplay-related bugs and improving the behavior of the Flash powerup.
[list][*]Fixed the Flash powerup not spawning in the Woodchuck Wood Inc. stage.[/*] [*]Tweaked the Flash powerup to make the character more controllable while in-air.[/*] [*]Fixed FXs not being played on remote clients when characters landed.[/*] [*]Fixed invisible characters not being slightly revealed upon landing on remote clients.[/*] [*]Fixed character footstep sounds being off-sync upon landing for remote clients.[/*] [*]The door in the Sun Temple stage now gibs dead bodies stuck in it.[/*] [*]Fixed incorrect button icons being displayed in menus after changing the controller type (i.e. from Xbox One to PS4).[/*] [*]Fixed combo box buttons in the Options screen remaining stuck after selecting another option.[/*] [/list] 
That’s it for now. Exciting things awaits in the upcoming weeks, starting with a new character! We look forward to your feedback here or [url=https://discord.gg/DNNbHc9]on Discord[/url].

notes.title: Devlog #6 - Early Access Release, Game Rules, Xbox One, Bug Fixes And More!
notes.notes:
We’re nearly there! Guntastic will unlock later today (at 6PM CET) on Steam Early Access. In this post I’d like to go over what we worked on in the past few weeks in preparation for the game’s release.

[h1]Customizable Game Rules[/h1]
Being able to customize how a match is played was one of the most popular request we got during the beta. So coming in the first Early Access release is the ability to change the [i]Kill Goal[/i] players need to reach to win the game and the [i]Round Time Limit[/i] after which players are forcibly eliminated.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34006915/a3e52fe2e5b8cf9b6fcf761abcd1c0512a2a75e3.gif[/img]
[i]Five kills matches are good for unforgiving duels between two players, while 20+ kills matches will likely last [b]a lot[/b]![/i]

Since changing these two simple values can already have a drastic effect on the game’s pace, we decided to limit the feature (at least for now!) to local couch games and online private games and to a limited set of options.
[list][*][b]Kill Goal:[/b] 5, 10 (default), 15, 20, 30.[/*][*][b]Round Time Limit:[/b] No limit, 15s, 20s, 25s (default), 30s.[/*][/list] 
More options will be considered and eventually added as we iterate on the feature. As always, we look forward to your feedback!

[h1]Discord Notifications[/h1] 
For last month’s beta we got [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/981630/announcements/detail/1582378649880608645]basic integration with Discord into the game[/url] so that you could see who was playing Guntastic by looking at his status. In the Early Access release of the game we added a feature that leverages Discord Webhooks to post a message into a dedicated [i]#matchmaking[/i] channel whenever someone is looking to play online.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34006915/dd633a088042ca8867915300a593f029d74b5649.png[/img]
[i]All hail the Guntastic bot![/i]

We hope this will give players a chance to find opponents more easily. For a future update we’d like to make join requests work seamlessly through Discord, so that you could then simply click on a player’s avatar to join the match on Steam.

[h1]Platform Support: Windows 32-bit and Xbox One[/h1] 
For the Early Access release we expanded the line-up of supported platforms to include Windows 32-bit (in addition to Windows 64-bit and macOS). We’re also excited to announce that [b]Guntastic will come to Xbox One in 2020![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34006915/a7203261c3dd498cdfd6e5c01ae522e2767643e2.png[/img]

(We received a few questions regarding Linux support, but I’m afraid we don’t have any definite plans for it at the moment. Each port brings several challenges – from development to testing – that we need to carefully evaluate before committing to it. Remember: we’re a very small studio! With Linux, what bothers me the most is testing due to how fragmented the ecosystem is.)

[h1]Bugs Fixes & Improvements[/h1] 
During last month’s open beta we received several bug reports related to the UI and the game itself. For this first Early Access release we decided to focus on the UI:
[list][*]Lobby: fixed an issue that would reset all players to use the same character in local games when the game window lost focus (i.e. because it was minimized).[/*][*]Lobby: fixed several issues with the character/level grids displaying out-of-date data during both local and online games.[/*][*]Lobby: clicking on a “Join” button should no longer join the player in a different slot.[/*] [*]Lobby: reduced flickering when switching between the character selection and level vote screen.[/*][*]Lobby: player join/leave sounds were fired incorrectly in certain cases.[/*][*]Accessibility: items in the character/level grids now have a mouse hover state.[/*][*]Game is now compiled using the [i]Shipping[/i] profile in UE4 for increased performance.[/*][/list] 
Keep those bug reports coming during Early Access! 😄 That’s it for now. We look forward to your feedback [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/981630/discussions/]here on Steam[/url] or [url=https://discord.gg/DNNbHc9]on Discord[/url]. See you soon in Early Access!
